An empty '''star system''' existed somewhere near the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]]. The ''[[Far Orbit]]'' used it to hide while some of its crew undertook a [[Mission to Brentaal IV|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].
